# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** housemother  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunty  <sub>[v3 c25 P3](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0003), [v3 c35 P2](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0002)</sub>; Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c19 P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041), [v3 c25 P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 c37 P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

Aunt Euphemia is a small, elderly woman with a gently triangular face and big, tender blue eyes that possess an irrepressible youthfulness. She has rose-colored cheeks and silver-white hair arranged in charming small rolls above her ears.

_Sources: [v3 c16 P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is a happy, good-humoured housemother who lives by the doctrine of fulfilling her duty to God, those around her, and herself while enjoying life. She is easily won over by constant, respectful manners. She considers Cressy Lindsay to be completely insane.

_Sources: [v3 c19 P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004), [v3 c20 P9](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0009), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)_

## Traits

- happy  <sub>[v3 c19 P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004)</sub>
- good-humoured  <sub>[v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>
- fear of snakes in India  <sub>[v3 c18 P25](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0025), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>

## Abilities

- cooking  <sub>[v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>

## History

After her only daughter Elizabeth married and departed for foreign missionary work in India, Aunt Euphemia was left alone in a large house and suffered terrible loneliness. She agreed to move to Portmaris to keep house for Nell, Honora, and their friends at Tabby's Place, bringing along her gray-and-white cat, the Sarah-cat. Over the course of three winters, she served as a beloved housemother to the girls residing there. She later traveled to India to investigate her daughter's mission field despite her intense fear of serpents.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c16 P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 c18 P25](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0025), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- father drowned before her birth and she was named Jamesina after him  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- grew up in a family with around six girls  <sub>[v3 c19 P41](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0041), [v3 c19 P42](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0042)</sub>
- used to laugh at and deride her past suitors  <sub>[v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021)</sub>
- advised a former suitor to wear an elastic strip to flatten his ears  <sub>[v3 c37 P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)</sub>
- was forbidden by her mother and husband from having a yellow silk dress  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>
- taught her daughter to cook before letting her attend university  <sub>[v3 c27 P6](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0006)</sub>
- received the Sarah-cat as a gift from her laundress  <sub>[v3 c16 P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)</sub>
- traveled to India despite a fear of snakes to investigate her daughter's mission field  <sub>[v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>

## Quotes

> Fulfill what you owe to God, to those around you, and to yourself, while enjoying your life. Such is the doctrine I live by, and it has served me quite effectively.  <sub>[v3 c19 P4](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0004)</sub>

> Obtaining a yellow silk dress is the absolute first action I intend to take upon arriving in heaven.  <sub>[v3 c19 P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006)</sub>

> Around six of them, my darling.  <sub>[v3 c19 P42](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0042)</sub>

> Deriding your suitors lacks propriety; however, it was my own constant habit.  <sub>[v3 c35 P21](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0021)</sub>
